title: Hydrogen Desktop (Windows / WSL2)
brief: The Windows (WSL2) platform layer for Hydrogen Desktop.
description: The Windows platform layer for Hydrogen Desktop, where the workspace runs in a WSL2 Ubuntu distro. Depends on adom/hd-bootstrap (the platform-generic HD layer) and adds everything specific to the WSL2 runtime: the WSL2/networking/lifecycle hd-* skills, the in-distro workspace-updater daemon, and the WSL2 code-server workbench seed. Sibling layers adom/hd-mac-bootstrap and adom/hd-ubuntu-bootstrap depend on the same adom/hd-bootstrap. This is the package the golden WSL2 image installs.
